A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An oxidized Chinese tea. Different flavors 
and fragrances can be brought out depending
on the degree of oxidation.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Té chino oxidado. Su sabor y su aroma
varían según el grado de oxidación.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A popular drink with a bunch of tapioca balls at the 
bottom. The chewy tapioca balls are made from 
the root of the cassava plant.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bebida popular con bolitas de tapioca
en el fondo. Estas bolitas masticables
se elaboran con la raíz de la yuca.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Hot water with grated ginger in it. It warms the body 
and prevents colds. It tastes delicious with honey 
mixed in.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Agua caliente con jengibre rallado.
Calienta el cuerpo y previene resfriados.
Sabe deliciosa con un poco de miel.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A drink based on the story of Cleopatra dissolving 
one of her pearl earrings in a cup of vinegar. 
Said to be good for beauty.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bebida basada en la historia de Cleopatra,
quien disolvió un arete de perla en vinagre.
Dicen que favorece la belleza.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A non-alcoholic drink based on a legendary alcoholic 
beverage said to make the drinker immortal. It neither
grants immortality, nor does it taste good.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Versión sin alcohol de un elixir legendario
que supuestamente otorga inmortalidad.
Ni te hace inmortal ni sabe bien.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An exclusive writing instrument for a maid to use 
to write messages on omelettes. Considered a
normal condiment by some people.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Útil exclusivo de sirvientas para escribir
mensajes sobre omelets. Algunos lo
consideran un condimento común.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A basic seasoning that's primarily made up of sucrose. 
Be careful not to consume too much of it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Condimento básico compuesto
principalmente de sacarosa.
Ten cuidado de no consumirlo en exceso.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A vegetable oil created from olives. If wielded 
correctly, it will make you look cool as you cook.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Aceite vegetal extraído de aceitunas.
Si lo usas bien, te verás genial al cocinar.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A freeze-dried slice of cake sold to the public as 
space food. It's both healthy and vegetarian-friendly.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Porción de pastel liofilizado que se vende
como comida espacial. Es saludable
y apta para vegetarianos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A gum that makes an explosive sound when it's fully blown 
and popped. Weak-hearted people should not chew it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Chicle que suena como una explosión
al inflarlo al máximo y reventarlo.
No es apto para gente asustadiza.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A British candy that's made by boiling down sugar, 
condensed milk, and butter, and then adding 
maple syrup. It's really sweet.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Dulce británico hecho con azúcar,
leche condensada y mantequilla hervidas,
más jarabe de arce. Es muy dulce.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A food that's made by straining water from plain yogurt.
The thick taste is popular and it is used in various dishes.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Se obtiene al quitarle el agua al yogur
natural. Su textura espesa es popular
y se usa en diversos platillos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Apples cut into bunny shapes. Often used as bait for 
certain animals and insects.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Manzanas cortadas en forma de conejito.
Se usan como cebo para ciertos
animales e insectos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A cup of ice cream engineered to never melt. It can be 
carried around for a long time, even in summer. But
it's so hard, ordinary spoons can't penetrate it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Helado que nunca se derrite, ni siquiera
en verano. Puedes llevarlo por horas,
pero es tan duro que una cuchara común
no logra atravesarlo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Sukiyaki-flavored caramels that combine the 
flavor of meat, soy sauce, eggs, and caramel.
The flavors are all really strong and don't mix well.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Caramelos con sabor a sukiyaki: carne,
salsa de soya, huevo y caramelo.
Los sabores son intensos y no combinan.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A sweet cigarette-shaped candy. It's popular among kids 
who want to imitate adults.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Golosina con forma de cigarrillo.
Popular entre niños que quieren
imitar a los adultos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A dumpling that's modeled after someone you swear
you've seen somewhere before. The skin is thick 
and a little tough.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Una gyoza con la cara de alguien que
jurarías haber visto antes. La masa
es gruesa y un poco dura.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A simple earring that can look good on anyone.
It's casually stylish.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Arete sencillo que le queda bien a todos.
Tiene un estilo discreto.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A bangle made out of common crystal glass. It's sparkly 
and draws quite a bit of attention.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Brazalete de vidrio común.
Su brillo llama mucho la atención.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A stylish tie both men and women can wear. 
It's convenient to have one around for special occassions.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Corbata elegante para hombres y mujeres.
Conviene tener una para ocasiones
especiales.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Enamel boots fit for a queen. They have high heels and
long laces decorated with a chain. Made to be worn 
as shoes, but usable as art or an umbrella holder.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Botas de charol dignas de una reina,
con tacones, cordones largos y cadenas.
Sirven de calzado, obra de arte
o paragüero.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A handcuff bracelet with the crest for the Ultimate Academy
emblazoned on it. It is a symbol of friendship, even in the 
face of death and despair.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Pulsera con forma de esposa y el escudo
de la Academia Definitiva. Simboliza
la amistad incluso ante la muerte
y la desesperación.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Easy-to-move workout clothes that wick away sweat.
With these, you can work out all day and still be comfortable.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Ropa cómoda que absorbe el sudor
y permite moverse con libertad.
Puedes ejercitarte todo el día con ella.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Popular Japanese summer clothes colored black and white,
like Monokuma. It's easy to move around in and breathes well.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Ropa japonesa de verano, blanca y negra
como Monokuma. Es fresca y permite
moverse con facilidad.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A chic autumn-colored scarf that can be used by men, 
women, and robots. It's very trendy and a fashionable
accent to any outfit.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bufanda elegante de tonos otoñales
para hombres, mujeres y robots.
Un toque de moda para cualquier atuendo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A sweater that's been knitted with love in every stitch. Those 
who wear it can feel themselves enveloped in the power 
of love and will stay warm through even the coldest winter.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Suéter tejido con amor en cada puntada.
Quien lo use sentirá el poder del amor
y tendrá abrigo hasta en el invierno
más frío.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A long coat with passionate red lining. It protects you 
from the cold and makes you burn with passion.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Abrigo largo con un forro rojo intenso.
Te protege del frío y te hace arder
de pasión.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A brush for painting nails beautifully. With this, anyone can
make their nails sparkle like magic. You can give it away, 
but something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Pincel que deja tus uñas brillantes
como por arte de magia. Puedes regalarlo,
pero quizá pase algo bueno si lo conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A blanket that will completely defend you from the cold by
closing off any gaps around your neck, hands, and feet. 
Moving around in it is near impossible.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Manta que cierra todo espacio junto
al cuello, las manos y los pies para
protegerte del frío. Moverse con ella
es casi imposible.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A size-adjustable beret. It's a pretty popular hat that 
lets you feel trendy and somewhat artistic.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Boina de tamaño ajustable. Un sombrero
popular que te hará sentir a la moda
y con un toque artístico.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A cute and fashionable brooch that resembles a 
seven-spotted ladybug. Despite how realistic it
looks, it is not alive.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Broche lindo y elegante con forma
de mariquita de siete puntos.
Aunque parece real, no está vivo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An accessory that is attached to the cuffs of a shirt. 
The black onyx design makes it look good on both 
men and women.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Accesorio para los puños de una camisa.
Su diseño de ónix negro queda bien
tanto en hombres como en mujeres.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A dog tag used to identify soldiers. The same profile is 
engraved on two plates so that if the owner is killed, 
one is collected to report the death.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Placa para identificar soldados.
Los datos se graban en dos placas:
si el dueño muere, se recoge una
para informar de su muerte.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A gentlemanly mustache that can be stuck on robots. 
Does not include antenna functions or earthquake powers.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bigote de caballero que se pega en robots.
No funciona como antena ni tiene
poderes sísmicos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A book of criminal offenses that contains records of the
cruelest, most atrocious murders committed by humans.
Many of these cases weren't released to the public.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Libro de delitos que recopila los crímenes
más crueles y atroces de la humanidad.
Muchos de estos casos nunca se hicieron
públicos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
How to raise hamsters...is not what this book is about. 
It's a book about raising domestic animals for meat. 
For those who are interested in the farming industry.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
No es un libro sobre criar hámsteres.
Trata sobre criar animales para carne.
Para interesados en la ganadería.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A thick journal packed with records of trips. However, 
it was actually written using vague knowledge and the
rich imagination of someone looking at a world map.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Grueso diario lleno de relatos de viajes.
En realidad, lo escribió alguien con
pocos conocimientos, mucha imaginación
y un mapa del mundo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A book that contains old magic gathered from all over the
country and collected in an easy to read volume for kids. Any
dangerous spells have been removed, so only love spells are left.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Libro infantil que reúne antiguas magias
de todo el país. Quitaron los hechizos
peligrosos, así que solo quedan
hechizos de amor.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A collection of stories about the customs, legends, 
and knowledge of civilizations from long ago. 
It has a high scientific value.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Historias sobre costumbres, leyendas
y saberes de civilizaciones antiguas.
Tiene un gran valor científico.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A teen magazine featuring many models just enjoying 
their summer. This magazine is meant for kids, not squids.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Revista juvenil con modelos que disfrutan
del verano. Es para jóvenes,
no para calamares.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An animal picture book for preschool kids. 
For some reason, bears are not featured in it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Libro ilustrado de animales para niños
de preescolar. Por alguna razón,
no incluye osos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A comprehensive catalog that features the latest cables, 
screws, motors, etc. It could be considered a fashion 
magazine for robots.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Catálogo completo de cables, tornillos,
motores y otras piezas modernas.
Sería una revista de moda para robots.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A circular silver tray that shines like a mirror. 
It is befitting of a maid.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bandeja circular plateada que brilla
como un espejo. Digna de una sirvienta.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A standard tennis ball four-pack set. Not only is it 
used for tennis, but it's also used for massages and 
weight-loss exercises.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Paquete de cuatro pelotas de tenis.
También se usan para masajes
y ejercicios para bajar de peso.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Top-grade, high-end headphones. Use these if you want
to truly hear the nuances in classical and jazz music.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Audífonos de la más alta calidad.
Ideales para apreciar los matices
de la música clásica y el jazz.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A typical stuffed toy bear that's not black and white. 
If you love it enough, then it might come to life one day.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Oso de peluche común, sin blanco y negro.
Si le das suficiente amor,
quizá cobre vida algún día.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A plain puzzle with one side as white as milk. It's said 
to be good for concentration training and is used 
for astronaut selection exams.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Rompecabezas con un lado blanco
como la leche. Entrena la concentración
y se usa en exámenes para astronautas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A miracle rod that can show a happy illusion when it's spun
in circles in front of someone's eyes.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Vara milagrosa que muestra una ilusión
feliz al girarla en círculos frente
a los ojos de alguien.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A pocket-sized mirror that is incredibly useful for 
checking your appearance.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Espejo de bolsillo muy útil
para revisar tu apariencia.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A case in high demand by cosplayers for its usability. 
Not only is it useful for conventions, but it's great 
for trips too.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Estuche muy solicitado por cosplayers
por su practicidad. Es ideal tanto
para convenciones como para viajes.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A glamorous black wig that has hair like that of a Japanese
doll. Even if you cut it, it grows back instantaneously.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Peluca negra de muñeca japonesa.
Aunque le cortes el cabello,
vuelve a crecer al instante.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A photo editing software that lets you retouch photos. 
Turn a plain, freckled face into something flashy!
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Programa para retocar fotos.
¡Convierte un rostro sencillo y pecoso
en algo deslumbrante!

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A basic sewing kit that has a needle and several colors of
thread. With this, you'll always be prepared in case a button
comes off.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Costurero básico con aguja e hilos
de varios colores. Así siempre
podrás arreglar un botón suelto.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A broom that lets mages fly at high speed when they sit on it.
It's a little bent, but it can also be used for cleaning.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Escoba que permite a los magos volar
a gran velocidad al montarla. Está algo
doblada, pero también sirve para limpiar.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A tattered handwritten music score. Rumor has it that it's
unpublished music from a certain famous composer.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Partitura manuscrita y desgastada.
Dicen que es una obra inédita
de cierto compositor famoso.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Traditional Japanese clothing. This particular kind is made 
of high-quality cotton and used for martial arts. 
Wear it when it's time to spar.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prenda japonesa tradicional de algodón
de alta calidad, usada en artes marciales.
Póntela cuando sea hora de combatir.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A fashion accessory that appears to be a pair of glasses,
but does not actually correct its wearer's vision.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Accesorio que parece un par de lentes,
pero no corrige la visión.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An origami pack that has 24 sheets of gold origami paper.
With this, you can create gorgeous origami.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Paquete con 24 hojas doradas para origami.
Con ellas puedes crear figuras preciosas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A plastic model of an actual buggy used by astronauts 
on the moon. It looks plain, but it's actually filled with
burning passion.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Maqueta de plástico de un vehículo lunar
que usaron astronautas de verdad.
Parece simple, pero está llena de pasión.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An electronic device that's equipped with an AI to produce
a new picture book every time it's turned on. Great for kids
who love hearing bed-time stories.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Aparato con IA que crea un nuevo libro
ilustrado cada vez que se enciende.
Ideal para niños que adoran
los cuentos antes de dormir.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A device for grip training. The strength of a punch is
determined by grip strength, weight, and speed combined.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Aparato para fortalecer el agarre.
La fuerza de un golpe depende del agarre,
el peso y la velocidad combinados.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A medal set Monokuma made of himself and the Monokubs.
You can feel the care he put into making it. You can give it
away, but something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Medallas que Monokuma hizo de él mismo
y de los Monokubs. Se nota su dedicación.
Puedes regalarlas, pero quizá pase
algo bueno si las conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A musical device that is used to match the tempo when
playing an instrument. A basic pendulum type.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Aparato para marcar el tempo al tocar
un instrumento. Es del tipo básico
con péndulo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An art book for sketches. It's pocket-sized so it's convenient
to carry around.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Cuaderno de dibujo para bocetos.
Su tamaño de bolsillo permite
llevarlo a todas partes.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A model doll that has the same joints as humans. 
It's pretty versatile and it can stay balanced in positions
humans can't maintain.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Muñeco con articulaciones humanas.
Es muy versátil y mantiene el equilibrio
en poses imposibles para una persona.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A carefully selected collection of fresh seeds for domestic
pigeons. Wild pigeons can't appreciate the increased quality,
so it would be a waste to give them these.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Semillas frescas escogidas para palomas
domésticas. Las silvestres no aprecian
su calidad, así que dárselas
sería un desperdicio.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A tool that can translate any language, even animal sounds. 
It can pick up a dog's bark and eloquently describe the 
emotions in it with an electronic voice.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Traduce cualquier idioma, incluso
sonidos animales. Capta un ladrido
y describe con elocuencia sus emociones
mediante una voz electrónica.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An opaque, gourd-shaped insect keeper. Used for keeping
bugs to listen to the noises they make.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Recipiente opaco con forma de calabaza.
Sirve para criar insectos y escuchar
los sonidos que producen.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A potted banyan tree with spirits living inside. It is said
to be good for luck. It grows aerial roots from the middle
of its trunk.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Banyán en maceta habitado por espíritus.
Dicen que trae suerte. Del tronco
le brotan raíces aéreas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A normal package of tissues. It's best to carry it 
alongside a handkerchief.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Paquete común de pañuelos desechables.
Conviene llevarlo junto a un pañuelo
de tela.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A ceramic figure from the Japanese Kofun period. It is said
to resemble a person dancing very intensely.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Figura de cerámica del período Kofun
japonés. Dicen que representa a alguien
bailando con mucho entusiasmo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
The ultimate work station with a comfy chair and so much
technology that you'll never want to get up. Those who sit
here will be in danger of becoming obese.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Puesto de trabajo con silla cómoda
y tanta tecnología que no querrás
levantarte. Quien se siente aquí
corre el riesgo de volverse obeso.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Regardless of whether it's hit by a kick from a sickly child
or a punch from a superhuman adult, this punching bag
will always break on the third hit.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Da igual si lo patea un niño enfermizo
o lo golpea un adulto sobrehumano:
este saco siempre se rompe
al tercer golpe.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A towel that's perfect for hanging around your neck to
wipe off sweat. It's the color of the bright, blue sky
on a youthful summer day.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Toalla ideal para llevar al cuello
y secar el sudor. Azul como el cielo
de un día de verano lleno de juventud.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A sturdy glasses case that won't break, even if it's stomped
on by an Exisal. No matter what abuse it takes, the glasses
inside will be kept safe.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Estuche que no se rompe ni bajo el pie
de un Exisal. Sin importar lo que sufra,
los lentes de dentro estarán a salvo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An oil that's necessary to have when making robots. It has 
started to separate, so the top half is diluted. Please be
sure to shake before use.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Aceite necesario para fabricar robots.
Se ha separado y la parte superior
está diluida. Agítalo antes de usar.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A pocket watch-shaped game console with monochrome 
LCD and several buttons. Play a game called "Factory" 
and mash buttons to create more bears!
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Consola con forma de reloj de bolsillo,
pantalla LCD monocroma y varios botones.
¡Juega a "Fábrica" y pulsa los botones
para crear más osos!

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A parasol with a stand so it can be used anywhere. Set it
up poolside to feel fancy! You can give it away, but
something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Sombrilla con base para usar donde sea.
¡Luce elegante junto a la piscina!
Puedes regalarla, pero quizá pase
algo bueno si la conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A family-size lunch box that can fit a variety of side dishes.
Perfect for a picnic.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Lonchera familiar con espacio para
muchas guarniciones. Ideal para un picnic.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A round, retro water bottle. Having it slung over your shoulder
makes you want to go on an adventure.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Cantimplora redonda de estilo retro.
Colgarla del hombro te dará ganas
de salir de aventura.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Squishy, colorful beads that swell to marble size when wet.
Good for both decoration and gardening. Lining up 4 of the
same color won't make them vanish.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bolitas blandas de colores que crecen
al mojarse. Sirven para decorar y cultivar.
Juntar cuatro del mismo color
no hará que desaparezcan.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
It humidifies your room based on the amount of tears you
have shed. Great for gloomy people, but to cheerful people,
it's just a paperweight.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Humidifica el cuarto según tus lágrimas.
Ideal para gente triste; para alguien
alegre, solo es un pisapapeles.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A compass that ignores the North Pole and South Pole, 
and instead points to the owner's loved one. 
A must-have for stalkers.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Brújula que ignora los polos y apunta
hacia el ser amado de su dueño.
Imprescindible para acosadores.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A ceramic doll that spins like a Whirling Dervish.
It's a very popular Turkish souvenir.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Muñeco de cerámica que gira como
un derviche. Un recuerdo muy popular
de Turquía.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A weathercock that imitates the Portuguese "Rooster of
Barcelos," A symbol of the truth, this is a popular souvenir
from Portugal.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Veleta que imita al gallo de Barcelos.
Símbolo de la verdad y recuerdo
muy popular de Portugal.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A pillow that helps you sleep well and gives you wonderful
dreams. However, the dreams will show an entire lifetime
making you feel intensely empty after you wake up.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Almohada que te brinda un buen descanso
y sueños maravillosos. Pero sueñas
toda una vida, y al despertar
sientes un vacío inmenso.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A card game with Japanese characters that relate to killing
games. Some cards are, "A metal bat kills demons," "Blackened
are soaked in blood," and, "Certain evidence over arguments."
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Juego de cartas japonesas sobre matanzas.
Incluye "Un bate mata demonios", "Culpables
bañados en sangre" y "Las pruebas
valen más que los argumentos".

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
The mummified hand of a monkey said to grant three wishes.
However, none of the wishes it grants have happy endings.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Mano momificada de mono que concede
tres deseos. Sin embargo, ninguno
termina bien.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An ornament that looks like a urinal. The more you look at it,
the more you start to question what art *really* is.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Adorno que parece un urinario.
Cuanto más lo miras, más te preguntas
qué es el arte en realidad.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A cool high-powered water gun. The water shoots over 
10 yards and it can fire continuously for a whole minute. 
Fun for kids and adults!
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Potente pistola de agua con un alcance
de más de nueve metros. Dispara sin parar
durante un minuto entero.
¡Divertida para niños y adultos!

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Object made out of borosilicate glass. Depending on the angle,
it changes form. The mysterious pattern is what makes it popular.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Objeto de vidrio de borosilicato que
cambia de forma según el ángulo.
Su misterioso diseño lo hace popular.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
The blackened might be one of us, so I refuse to stay 
with you guys! I'm gonna go hide in my room!
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
¡El culpable podría ser uno de ustedes!
¡No pienso quedarme aquí!
¡Me esconderé en mi cuarto!

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
The chance of this succeeding is only 5%. No one has ever
made it out alive before...but this is my last chance to survive.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Solo hay un 5% de posibilidades de éxito.
Nadie ha salido con vida...pero esta
es mi última oportunidad de sobrevivir.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A robot mascot that looks like a killer whale. It can sense
when its owner is distressed, and offers to research a solution.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Mascota robótica con forma de orca.
Detecta si su dueño está angustiado
y ofrece investigar una solución.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A mini planetarium machine that can project the cosmos
onto your bedroom walls when it's time for bed. Comes 
with narration voiced by a popular voice actor.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Miniplanetario que proyecta el cosmos
en las paredes de tu cuarto al dormir.
Incluye narración de un actor
de voz popular.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A shiny button that makes its owner feel like their luck
will turn around. It may or may not pull in a powerful
wave of luck.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Botón brillante que hace sentir a su dueño
que su suerte cambiará. Puede atraer
una poderosa ola de suerte...o no.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A cleaning sheet that gets rid of any mess in the kitchen
sink or even dirt on the faucet. Can also be used 
to clean robots.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Paño que quita cualquier suciedad
del fregadero y del grifo.
También sirve para limpiar robots.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Bedding created by hanging a net between two poles
or trees. Lounging in one of these is something everyone 
has dreamed of at least once.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Red colgada entre dos postes o árboles
para descansar. Todos han soñado
alguna vez con relajarse en una.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A spray air freshener. It has holy water mixed in, 
and is said to repel ghosts and paranormal entities.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Ambientador en aerosol con agua bendita.
Dicen que ahuyenta fantasmas
y seres paranormales.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
"Loves me, loves me not, loves me..." An artificial flower 
used for flower fortune-telling. It has an odd number of
petals to soothe the pain of unrequited love.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
"Me quiere, no me quiere, me quiere..."
Flor artificial para adivinar el amor.
Tiene pétalos impares para aliviar
el dolor del amor no correspondido.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Marigold seeds that bloom into colorful flowers. 
By the way, marigolds symbolize "despair."
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Semillas de caléndula que dan flores
coloridas. Por cierto, la caléndula
simboliza la "desesperación".

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A set of cards containing four rocks, four papers, 
and four scissors. If you bet your life on this game,
it can be a thrilling psychological battle.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Cartas con cuatro piedras, cuatro papeles
y cuatro tijeras. Si apuestas tu vida,
puede ser una intensa batalla psicológica.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A replica of a laser gun used by upstanding citizens to punish
rebellious or unhappy people. When carrying this around,
be sure to watch your coefficient.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Réplica de la pistola láser con que buenos
ciudadanos castigan a rebeldes e infelices.
Vigila tu coeficiente cuando la lleves.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A replica of a student ID from some academy. There are as
many different designs of ID as there are talented students.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Réplica de una credencial estudiantil.
Hay tantos diseños como estudiantes
talentosos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A headband with Monokuma ears. When worn, it picks up your
brainwaves and the ears wiggle according to your emotions.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Diadema con orejas de Monokuma.
Capta tus ondas cerebrales y mueve
las orejas según tus emociones.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A party game of hope and despair. Draw cards and become
the characters to start deducing and debating! Now on sale!
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Juego de fiesta de esperanza y desesperación.
¡Saca cartas, interpreta a los personajes,
deduce y debate! ¡Ya a la venta!

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An extremely handy reacher grabber. Once you use it,
you can't live without it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Pinza extensible muy práctica.
Cuando la pruebes, no podrás vivir sin ella.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Toy blocks made out of rice, so they're safe for babies
to put in their mouths. But they'll go bad if they aren't
eaten right away.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bloques de arroz seguros para bebés
que se los llevan a la boca.
Pero se echan a perder si no se comen pronto.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Aluminum film that makes excellent insulation. It warms
your body when you wrap it around yourself, making it
handy for outdoor activities.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Lámina de aluminio con gran aislamiento.
Abriga al envolver el cuerpo, por lo que
resulta útil para actividades al aire libre.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A shaved ice machine that automatically crushes up ice
and pours strawberry syrup on top.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Máquina de raspados que tritura hielo
y añade jarabe de fresa automáticamente.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A model of an imaginary weapon. It's powerful, but only the
worthy may fire it. Embrace it to feel a man's fantasy. You can
give it away, but something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Modelo de un arma imaginaria poderosa
que solo los dignos pueden disparar.
Abrázala y siente la fantasía masculina.
Quizá pase algo bueno si la conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
An ornamental katana that contains a divine power capable
of taking out ordinary people with a single slash. You can 
give it away, but something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Katana decorativa de poder divino, capaz
de abatir a cualquiera de un solo corte.
Puedes regalarla, pero quizá pase
algo bueno si la conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A black-ish belt worn with karate clothes. It can only be
worn by those with justice in their hearts. You can give it
away, but something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Cinturón negruzco de karate que solo
pueden usar quienes llevan la justicia
en el corazón. Puedes regalarlo, pero
quizá pase algo bueno si lo conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Kaito's favorite boxers. The universe is always burning
in the most important parts.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Los bóxers favoritos de Kaito. El universo
siempre arde en las partes más importantes.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Ryoma's favorite briefs. At a certain national tennis
competition, everyone was required to wear all white,
down to their underwear.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Los calzoncillos favoritos de Ryoma.
En cierto torneo nacional de tenis exigían
vestir de blanco hasta la ropa interior.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Rantaro's favorite boxers. At first glance, they look simple,
but once you touch them, you can tell they're made of
high quality material.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Los bóxers favoritos de Rantaro. Parecen
sencillos, pero al tocarlos se nota
la calidad del material.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Gonta's favorite loincloth. For a while, he wore tailored briefs,
but he couldn't get used to close-fitting underwear since he 
grew up in the forest.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
El taparrabos favorito de Gonta. Usó
calzoncillos a medida un tiempo, pero
al haberse criado en el bosque nunca
se acostumbró a la ropa interior ajustada.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Kokichi's favorite trendy underwear. Being a tease where 
it can't be seen is what true fashion is all about.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior de moda favorita de Kokichi.
Provocar donde nadie ve: eso es
la verdadera moda.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Korekiyo's favorite bikini bottom. The stoic color and 
sexy form represent the beauty of humanity.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
El bikini favorito de Korekiyo.
Su color sobrio y su forma sensual
representan la belleza humana.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Parts built in to Keebo's waist. They protect the delicate parts 
of his body from temperature and humidity. They need to be
changed daily, but can be reused after being washed.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Piezas de la cintura de Keebo que protegen
sus partes delicadas del calor y la humedad.
Hay que cambiarlas a diario, pero
se pueden lavar y reutilizar.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Kirumi's favorite panties. An elegant pair of underwear 
with deep purple lace.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Kirumi.
Un elegante par con encaje morado oscuro.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Himiko's favorite panties. She wears pumpkin panties 
out of respect for a certain magical girl.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Himiko.
Usa bombachos en homenaje
a cierta chica mágica.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Maki's favorite panties. They're easy to move in and have
a tie on the side.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Maki.
Permite moverse con facilidad
y se anuda a un costado.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Tenko's favorite panties. Although they're spats, the small
Japanese flowers printed on them express her femininity.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Tenko.
Son shorts ajustados, pero sus florecitas
japonesas expresan su feminidad.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Tsumugi's favorite panties. She usually wears plain panties,
but these are for special occasions. They're not for show, 
so no panty shots allowed!
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Tsumugi.
Suele usar prendas simples, pero estas
son para ocasiones especiales. No son
para exhibir: ¡nada de fotos indiscretas!

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Angie's favorite bikini bottom. Since it's not underwear,
it's totally fine if it peeks out a little.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
El bikini favorito de Angie.
Como no es ropa interior, no importa
si se asoma un poquito.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Miu's favorite panties. Special underwear worthy of 
adorning her "busty, brainy, beautiful goddess body."
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Miu.
Digna de adornar su "cuerpo de diosa
tetona, hermosa y brillante".

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Kaede's favorite panties. A basic and popular pink color
with modest lace.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Kaede.
De un rosa clásico y popular,
con encaje discreto.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A cushion that expresses the will of the outside world to
abandon killing games and watch human relationships instead.
This unlocks "Love Across the Universe."
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Cojín que expresa el deseo del mundo
exterior de ver relaciones humanas
en vez de matanzas. Desbloquea
"Amor a Través del Universo".

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A key to a certain place filled with greed and lust. You can
give it away, but something good might happen if you keep it.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Llave de un lugar lleno de codicia y lujuria.
Puedes regalarla, pero quizá pase
algo bueno si la conservas.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A lucky roulette with ups and downs that can impact people's
lives. This unlocks "Ultimate Talent Development Plan."
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Ruleta de la suerte cuyos altibajos cambian
vidas. Desbloquea el "Plan de Desarrollo
del Talento Definitivo".

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A legendary sword said to have sliced apart the despair that
covered the entire world. This unlocks "Monokuma's Test."
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Espada legendaria que cortó la desesperación
que cubría el mundo. Desbloquea
"La Prueba de Monokuma".

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared the Prologue. It's a badge of the 
Ultimate Academy insignia. Apparently, there are only 
16 of these in the world.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el prólogo.
Insignia de la Academia Definitiva.
Al parecer, solo existen 16 en el mundo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared Chapter 1. A memento of Kaede.
No matter the hardship, there was always a deep melody
playing in her heart...
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el capítulo 1.
Recuerdo de Kaede. Ante toda adversidad,
una profunda melodía sonaba en su corazón...

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared Chapter 2. A memento of Kirumi.
She always wore them as she worked for everyone's sake.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el capítulo 2.
Recuerdo de Kirumi. Siempre los usaba
mientras trabajaba por el bien de todos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared Chapter 3. A memento of Korekiyo.
It covers the mouth and neck to hide them from view.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el capítulo 3.
Recuerdo de Korekiyo. Oculta
la boca y el cuello.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared Chapter 4. A memento of Gonta.
Left empty after no one remained to care for the insects.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el capítulo 4.
Recuerdo de Gonta. Quedó vacía al no
haber nadie que cuidara a los insectos.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared Chapter 5. A memento of Kaito.
It depicts his fantasies of the universe.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el capítulo 5.
Recuerdo de Kaito. Refleja
sus fantasías sobre el universo.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared Chapter 6. A memento of Tsumugi.
It's a badge the Team Danganronpa employees wear.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el capítulo 6.
Recuerdo de Tsumugi. Es la credencial
que usan los empleados del Equipo Danganronpa.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Proof that you've cleared the Epilogue. The traditional item 
awarded at the end of a Danganronpa.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Prueba de que completaste el epílogo.
El objeto tradicional que recibes
al final de un Danganronpa.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
Shuichi's favorite underwear. Don't assume the plaid pattern
represents culprits or detectives, or anything of the sort.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
La ropa interior favorita de Shuichi.
No creas que los cuadros representan
a culpables, detectives ni nada parecido.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A ticket that's used in the "Love Across the Universe" show.
You're only allowed to use it with someone you've collected
Friendship Fragments from.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Boleto para "Amor a Través del Universo".
Solo puedes usarlo con alguien de quien
hayas obtenido fragmentos de amistad.

A-PresentSetumei.stx.en:
A suspicious-looking energy drink. Not only will it increase 
your energy a hundredfold, but it can also manipulate 
time itself.
A-PresentSetumei.stx.es:
Bebida energética de aspecto sospechoso.
Multiplica tu energía por cien
y hasta puede manipular el tiempo.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Increases maximum influence a little.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Envious Influence.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta un poco la influencia máxima.
Funciona durante todo el juicio escolar.
Incompatible con Influencia envidiable.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Increases maximum influence a lot.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Attentive Influence.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta mucho la influencia máxima.
Funciona durante todo el juicio escolar.
Incompatible con Influencia atenta.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Increases maximum focus a little.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Menacing Focus.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta un poco el enfoque máximo.
Funciona durante todo el juicio escolar.
Incompatible con Enfoque temible.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Increases maximum focus a lot.
Effective during all parts of the class trial.
Can't be combined with Extraordinary Focus.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta mucho el enfoque máximo.
Funciona durante todo el juicio escolar.
Incompatible con Enfoque extraordinario.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Slightly increases the time limit in 
each phase. Effective during all
parts of the class trial.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta un poco el tiempo límite
de cada fase. Funciona durante
todo el juicio escolar.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Increases amount of influence recovered
by right answers. Effective during 
Nonstop Debates and choices.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta la influencia que recuperas
al acertar en opciones de respuesta
y en el Debate Sin Parar.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Makes the reticle shake less. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates. 
Can't be combined with Tranquility.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Reduce el temblor de la mira en Debate
Sin Parar y Debate de Pánico Masivo.
Incompatible con Tranquilidad.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Makes the reticle stop shaking. Effective
during Nonstop and Mass Panic Debates. 
Can't be combined with Cool and Composed.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Evita el temblor de la mira en Debate
Sin Parar y Debate de Pánico Masivo.
Incompatible con Calma y compostura.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Slows the speed of the reticle. 
Effective during Nonstop Debates. 
Can't be combined with Upshift.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Reduce la velocidad de la mira.
Funciona en Debate Sin Parar.
Incompatible con Acelerar.

A-SkillSetumei.stx.en:
Increases the speed of the reticle.
Effective during Nonstop Debates.
Can't be combined with Downshift.
A-SkillSetumei.stx.es:
Aumenta la velocidad de la mira.
Funciona en Debate Sin Parar.
Incompatible con Marcha baja.
